description: Réseau de transports collectifs Naolib is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Nantes Métropole. Réseau de transports collectifs Naolib Ce jeu de données regroupe les différents flux disponibles pour décrire et suivre en temps réel les services de transport public Naolib de Nantes Métropole, selon les principaux standards d’échange de données du secteur de la mobilité. Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are transport en commun, gtfs, GTFS-RT, siri, siri-lite, Naolib. The portal shows 8 records. The portal shows 2025-06-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
